label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The first Tab stops go to a cookie notice link, Manage and Decline buttons; after declining, focus jumped back to the top and a stray button reading How can we use your data came next, so the banner flow was confusing
The header puts a country selector with about 200 options, Industry Pricing links, a hidden search panel and many menu links before any product, so reaching content by Tab took over 40 key presses
The Skip to Content link did not help: it came after the cookie banner in tab order, and the search suggestion links (Griddle, [name] and others) stay focusable even though the search panel is closed

The first product card was a link with no accessible name, so I could not tell what I was opening; the page also kept my old focus position after activating a link, so focus did not reset to the top of the new page

After the product page loaded, focus landed in the footer email field and the only way back to the Add to Cart button was Shift+Tab through a related-products carousel of 20 or more cards, then reviews with Report and Show more buttons, so I ran out of steps before reaching Add to Cart
